note: Acceptance requirements, not test results. Record metadata only; never include prompts, completions, keys or entity spans.

native_iac: Export reviewed native unified API artifact with official ARM contract and exact API version
Terraform reproducibly creates aliases/translation/models endpoint, updates it, and removes it in an approved disposable environment
No undocumented type/format/model schema, policy, local-exec portal automation or adapter
subscription_bearer: OpenAI SDK bearer-only key authenticates through native APIM subscription validation
Missing, invalid, revoked, wrong-product, expired/suspended subscriptions fail
Conflicting bearer/header credentials fail; query credentials fail without secret logging
Product-scoped and all-access subscriptions cannot bypass API/global policy
Backend capture proves no customer key forwarded
public_edge_origin: Public WAF_v2 HTTPS AppGW, DNS, matching Key Vault certificate and renewal path validated
HTTPS backend SNI, 200 health probes, WAF request inspection and timeout/cancellation validated
App Service and SCM deny untrusted public origins while allowing AppGW Microsoft.Web service endpoint and explicit reviewed operator /32
Entra-only SQL allows only reviewed operator and actual App Service outbound IPv4 rules, never 0.0.0.0 AllowAzureServices
Public AI/Key Vault/storage require identity/RBAC; no shared keys or anonymous data access
Before inference release, native APIM origin control live-proves direct public bypass denial while allowing AppGW; deny-all remains until then
Basic v2 outbound IP is not assumed deterministic; authenticated model endpoints verified
Edge cache disabled, request buffering on, SSE response buffering off and WAF no-sensitive-log behavior validated
pii_structure_unicode: All accepted user-bearing roles/history including system/developer/assistant text inspected
Tool descriptions, free-text arguments, tool results and assistant tool-call history inspected
Sensitive typed/schema-bound values fail closed rather than breaking contracts
Overlap-aware chunks obey Language document/batch limits
Unicode supplementary characters, combining marks, span merge and boundary overlaps preserve JSON structure
Controlled provider capture proves no tested original PII reaches a model endpoint
pii_fail_closed: Timeout, 429, 5xx, malformed/partial document results and language failures reject
original_redacted_safety: Original input checked in request-local memory before PII redaction
Every configured harm threshold exercises allowed and blocked boundary cases
prompt_shields: Direct and context injection fixtures checked on original and forwarded input
Shields dependency failures reject; limitations disclosed
response_safety: Unsafe ordinary text rejected before buffered response leaves APIM
Moderation timeout/429/5xx/malformed dependency responses fail closed
sse_sliding_window: Timestamped incremental OpenAI SDK events prove live streaming, not full-response buffering
Overlapping boundary violation stops subsequent events
Moderation error stops stream; after delivery no fabricated HTTP 403
Client cancellation and incomplete usage visible; partial stream never retried/resumed
tools_inspection: Tools/tool_choice/parallel calls, definitions, results, assistant history translate without dropping fields
PII and safety inspect arguments including stream delta boundaries
IDs/types/schema keys preserved; unsafe typed values reject
No tool execution; unfinished tool arguments treated as failure
json_schema_inspection: Strict JSON schema/output formats translate for every advertised provider
PII redaction preserves field types/schema keys/contracts
Response moderation inspects nested/string values and streamed JSON
Incomplete JSON/blocked stream not reported as a successful schema-valid result
model_region_access: Each configured deployment/provider/version and commercial eligibility confirmed
Public TLS connectivity and endpoint authentication verified for every pool member without hardcoded Basic v2 outbound IPs
Only proved capability/model combinations advertised; unavailable formats explicitly reject
pool_retry_after: Equivalent deployments only; no silent model substitution
Equal priority/weight approximate distribution observed across healthy peers
429 Retry-After seconds/date and long intervals respected; circuit recovery demonstrated
Fallback/transient bounded retries only before response content
Exhausted pool returns explicit error/retry guidance; no retry for auth/validation/safety failures
subscription_model_limits: Explicit IDS RPM/TPM/quota period/value/max-response-token configuration supplied
Counter isolation between subscriptions/models and model-only counters demonstrated
Sequential limit/error/Retry-After results and measured concurrent overshoot recorded
Streaming token estimates and distributed gateway-local counters documented
metadata_correlation: Validated CorrelationId joins GatewayLogs and GatewayLlmLog without customer-supplied attribution
Actual selected backend endpoint, alias, provider and model region emitted from trusted selection
Pool ID or gateway Region not substituted for actual backend region
Token semantics, retries, delayed duplicates, safety stops and cancellations reconciled
Unknown cache-token/TTFT/retry usage remains missing, not zero or latency proxy
no_sensitive_logs: All HTTP/LLM diagnostic message capture disabled or omitted
Known synthetic payload/key markers absent from all enabled sinks including failure paths
WAF matched-value/access URL logs not enabled without independently proved sanitization
No raw APIM traces/debug credentials/entity mappings/provider secrets/customer keys persisted
